in_sanskrit.name: जाननी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who knows or feels deeply; a mother

in_marathi.name: Janani
in_marathi.long_meaning: Janani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Janani is a Sanskrit term that signifies 'Mother' or 'Nurturer'. In Hindu mythology, Janani is the divine embodiment of compassionate love and selfless care. Janani is revered as the ultimate giver, nurturing all forms of life, from the universe to her own children.
